name: Modbus Client → On Custom Response
description: Fires instead of `on_response` when the reply doesn't parse as a standard-conforming transaction for this function code. Lambda variables: `request`, `response` (raw `std::span<const uint8_t>` PDUs) - the same shape `modbus_client.send`'s `on_response` uses, so a non-conforming device is still handleable. If left unconfigured, no handler runs for that transmission - the first non-conforming reply for this action logs a warning, and any after that log at verbose level instead.
